notes.title: Indie Game Sim v1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/6a651a007c24b2ae08691e0be7eb1112456cc55f.png[/img]

[b]Oh, hello. It's me again! We have met, right?

Doubtful, not that it matters ...

INDIE GAME SIM is obviously beyond help, what a MEDIOCRE game! But for some reason there is an UPDATE today, with the following changes:

* Add changelog scene
* Terminal scene to dump data to dev
* Improve game-rating algorithm. (100% isn't so easy anymore, is it?!)
* Add light to copycat
* Add another secret

Not that anyone will notice. Enjoy playing some BETTER game! bahaha[/b]
